description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git reset' and its effect on directory structures and files within a Git repository. It defines a series of test cases to verify that empty directories are correctly culled after a reset operation.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the given commands and verifying their success.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a directory.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that the specified path does not exist.
